rolling_guard.input: Actual completed P calls from seed onward in frozen dispatch order; skipped or uncertain attempts do not count as new completed calls
rolling_guard.stop: Two adjacent REPETITION_ABORT calls, or two adjacent OUTPUT_TRUNCATED calls; save current first, dispatch no next P
rolling_guard.reset: OK resets streak. A different technical status breaks same-category adjacency; different repetition diagnostics are preserved under the repetition failure category.
rolling_guard.repeat_source: Existing record_guard/repetition_guard and raw-response/token-ids retained; no new detection threshold

per_saved_P: Frozen conversion, merge, production and independent recomputation; technical success/failure, readable parts, preserved records, local dispositions and compatible source-reviewed TRAIN/DEV labels counted separately
effective_supervision: Count only unchanged admitted source-reviewed labels for terminal case parts. Raw readable P or structurally available use is not automatically a training label. References used for accounting only, never fed to proposals/checks/learner input.
shared_engineering_stop: Pause after saved current for source/version integrity failure, production/independent recomputation disagreement, record-retention mismatch, reference leakage flag or import exception. Natural local semantic errors retain original content and frozen isolation. Other suspected common omissions/connections require impact diagnosis before a separate repair version.

current_transition.effect: Current process saves P02 at original limits then stops. New process uses this supplement; edits do not alter live process. If P02 triggers same-category second failure, do not resume.

engineering_acceptance.actual_cached_entry_recompute: 10 cases including no-readable seed; 9 readable cases, independent recomputation OK; 134 compatible labels preserved
